verdict.rationale: Docs state Claude Code skills follow the open 'Agent Skills' standard which 'works across multiple AI tools' (agentskills.io spec), implying cross-agent portability, and the spec itself defines a tool-agnostic SKILL.md format. However, there is no concrete evidence of per-harness install instructions or documented support for Codex, Cursor, or other named agents — all install/marketplace instructions (plugin marketplace, /plugin install, container skill_id) are Claude-specific. Missing for 10: explicit Codex/Cursor installation docs, per-harness setup instructions, and independent confirmation that the same skill collection actually runs unmodified in non-Anthropic tools.
